taxonomy.label: Knowledge gap
taxonomy.description: The learner did not know the condition, medication, procedure or nursing principle.

taxonomy.label: English wording
taxonomy.description: The learner misunderstood key words such as first, priority, expected, follow-up or further teaching.

taxonomy.label: Cue recognition
taxonomy.description: The learner missed the most important cue or treated all cues as equal.

taxonomy.label: Prioritization
taxonomy.description: The learner identified the issue but chose a non-urgent or less safe action.

taxonomy.label: Delegation / scope
taxonomy.description: The learner assigned an RN task to another role or failed to delegate a routine stable task.

taxonomy.label: Safety / infection control
taxonomy.description: The learner missed fall risk, aspiration risk, isolation, hand hygiene, medication safety or similar safety concern.

taxonomy.label: Therapeutic communication
taxonomy.description: The learner chose a response that blocks feelings, gives false reassurance, argues or changes subject too quickly.

taxonomy.label: Test strategy
taxonomy.description: The mistake came from rushing, overthinking, changing answers without evidence or mismanaging time.
